source.snippet: If you ask who would pay for Apple local models, I would. A Mac Studio high end 512GB costs ~$1000/month for 3 years versus my current run rate of ~$1000/month for five devs for Claude Ultra (or ~$10k/week for Claude Sonnet if I paid API rates rather than Ultra). If/when Anthropic changes to pure API pricing, or for API-heavy projects, that's when I'd switch to more local models.

problem_statement: Development teams paying $1,000+/month for cloud AI subscriptions lack a reliable, low-friction way to evaluate when switching specific workloads to local models would be cost-effective, and have no tooling to manage or monitor that hybrid threshold in practice.
target_segment: Engineering leads and CTOs at small software teams (2–20 devs) with active cloud AI spend above $500/month
notes: Single but highly credible HN commenter with explicit spend figures: $1k/mo for 5-dev team on Claude Ultra, noting $10k/week equivalent at API rates. Buyer is clearly price-sensitive and actively considering alternatives. Opportunity: a cost-tracking + local-vs-cloud routing advisor tool for dev teams. Willingness to pay implied by current subscription spend.
